about: The staged ground ladder: raw regolith, washed regolith, rich soil, biocrust. Each step is a block the player makes by one visible action. Every amount in the recipes is INVENTED game balance. Washing as a way to remove perchlorate is game design and NOT VERIFIED (Phoenix found perchlorate in Mars soil and it dissolves in water, docs/science/round2-review.md 1.5; no source says washing makes Mars soil farmable). Rich soil needs bone meal, and the first planter needs none (it works on washed regolith with water), so there is no loop: bone meal comes from crops, crops grow on washed regolith. The soil treatment unit and the seed kits also use bone meal (docs/design/seed-kit-recipes.md section 2). What placing a kit does is W3.

steps.name: washed regolith
steps.action: 4 red sand and a water bucket make 4 (bucket comes back)

steps.name: rich soil
steps.action: 4 washed regolith and 1 bone meal make 4

steps.name: biocrust
steps.action: a biocrust kit starts it on rich soil (placing is W3)
